records.name: GoodLads

records.description: AI growth manager for Google Ads accounts. GoodLads generates hypotheses to improve your ROAS or CPA, ships each one in one click - never without your approval - and tracks it on a kanban board to a verdict.

records.name: Relaticle
records.tagline: Open-source CRM with approval-gated AI writes
records.description: Most CRMs bolt AI on. Relaticle is built agent-first: any MCP client gets 37 first-party tools over OAuth, with workspace custom fields in each agent's schema automatically. records.name: SODAX SDK
records.tagline: Digital asset flows you can build and deploy with AI.
records.description: SODAX provides a highly customizable execution system to build stablecoin, crypto and real world asset transactions. Focus on your product and user experience without the technical debt of managing the interface with blockchain technology. Neobanks, exchanges, lending and yield protocols integrate the SODAX SDK to ship our full range of features, across transaction, lending and yield, faster and extend their operational reach across blockchain networks. SODAX is infrastructure for modern money.

records.name: bonds
records.tagline: AI messenger that builds shared apps inside your group chats
records.description: Just talk, and the apps your group or friends needs appear in the chat. "We're 4 friends training for a marathon, build us a tracker" becomes a real app: leaderboard, streaks, a $500 pot, and the AI poking whoever skips a run. Shared software, generated on the fly: native iOS UI, one live state for the whole chat, zero setup. Full-blown social apps, not widgets. We're starting with fitness. A real messenger. Free.

records.name: Trancy Air
records.tagline: Translate anything you see, write, or say with one hotkey

In any app: select what you can't read and it's translated; write in your own language and one key swaps it to another; too lazy to type, just talk. It also catches mistakes, polishes wording, reads text aloud and scores your pronunciation.

records.name: AppGacha
records.tagline: Turn a sentence into a tiny desktop app

records.name: TapCraft
records.tagline: App Demo Studio for mobile apps

Drop in an Android or iOS screen recording, wrap it in a real Pixel / iPhone / Galaxy frame, add tap ripples (click to place, or import exact coordinates from adb), auto-zoom the camera, cover the recorder's red chip, and export 1080 or 2K. records.name: Switch

records.description: Switch brings AI agents into the collaboration tools your team already uses. Each room carries its own context, participants, and rules. Works with Claude Code, OpenAI, Google ADK, LangChain, and more. Open source, self-hostable, running in minutes.

records.name: Catenary
records.tagline: Spatial canvas IDE for AI coding agents
records.description: Catenary is a spatial IDE and terminal orchestrator that reimagines coding with AI agents. records.name: Lyrimuse
records.tagline: Word-synced macOS lyrics that pick the right version
records.description: Word-synced desktop lyrics for Apple Music, Spotify, QQ Music, NetEase, Kugou, and for YouTube Music or Spotify Web in a browser. Shows up as a floating overlay, a Dynamic Island capsule, an Apple-Music-style window, or in the menu bar. Free and open source, no account.

records.name: OpenMarket
records.tagline: Multi-agent marketplace where proof decides who wins

OpenMarket (in research preview), is a multi-agent marketplace where sellers pitch, competitors challenge their claims, and independent truth agents verify the evidence as they compete to earn a buyer's sale. Here, claims don’t count just because they’re written on a product page. They have to survive scrutiny and be proven.

records.name: Widgo
records.tagline: AI Sales rep for your website visitors
records.description: Widgo is an AI sales rep on your website. It scans your site, adds any docs you give it, and answers every visitor from that alone. It identifies the company, scores the lead, and books the demo on your calendar. One line of code. Free forever, no card.

records.name: Nametag
records.tagline: Your social memory to never forget a name and person again
records.description: People love you when you remember their name. Nametag AI is a simple app that helps you remember names of people you meet. By using location, Nametag remembers where you met a person so that the next time you visit you can review your flashcard cram deck before walking in. To save someone, simply tap and speak. "Jake, tall, mustache glasses, loves cooking, knows Jane." Nametag AI takes the voice capture and categorizes the information automatically into descriptors, mutuals, & fun facts.

records.name: Coherence X6 for macOS
records.tagline: Turn websites into Mac apps powered by your browser
records.description: Coherence X6 turns websites into isolated, customizable Mac apps powered by Chrome and other Chromium browsers. Bring your profiles, logins, bookmarks, and extensions, then control how each app looks, opens, and routes links.

records.name: Knockin'
records.tagline: Turns your static bio into an AI business card that replies
records.description: Knockin turns your bio into an AI business card people can chat with. Add your work, links, and content. It learns what you do and answers questions in your voice. Visitors can book time with you right away, even when you’re away. Knockin remembers who stopped by, so you know who to follow up with. This cuts down on back and forth and gives both sides more context before a call.

records.name: Replay QA Security Scan

records.description: Replay pentests your web app on every QA pass now: injection flaws, broken access control, IDOR, the stuff AI-generated code tends to miss. Same projects also test against dev, staging, prod, and localhost, so you're not maintaining separate QA setups per environment.

records.name: Dictantor

Supported recordings can sync through your private iCloud account.

records.name: Tables.so

You get a scored list with emails, phone numbers and the sources behind every answer, so you can check it. Syncs with HubSpot, Pipedrive and Attio, and works on LinkedIn and inside Claude.

records.name: Kopai

Analytics count what an agent costs to run separately from what it earns. A one-command benchmark runs it against reference agents before you ship. Certification expires, and answers get re-checked. Chat and the API use the same engine, so an exported agent behaves like the one you tested.

Server monitoring, port forwarding, SFTP, import from PuTTY. Capstone project that turned real. Still just me.

records.name: Readalix
records.tagline: Offline text to speech that highlights every word
records.description: Readalix reads any page aloud and lights up the word and the sentence as it speaks, so you never lose your place. It works where other readers give up: web pages, form fields, Chrome's and Edge's PDF viewers, Google Docs, Slides, Word and PowerPoint Online. 100+ Piper, Kokoro and Supertonic voices in 30+ languages run on your device, so nothing you read leaves it. Microsoft's neural voices need no key. Bring your own Gemini or OpenAI key. No account, no sign-up, no floating buttons.

records.name: Powst
records.tagline: Send B2B postcards in minutes
records.description: Powst — Pick local UK business leads and mail postcards in 3 mins 🚀 Skip cold emails. Target 4M+ UK companies with automated direct mail.

records.name: Concertoi
records.tagline: Free interactive sheet music for piano
records.description: Concertoi is a free piano sheet-music platform built to make practising easier. Instead of just displaying a PDF, Concertoi lets you follow the sheet music while the piece plays, so you can see the notation and hear the music at the same time. You can browse and download piano sheet music for free, with interactive playback available for supported pieces. The goal is simple: make practising with sheet music more convenient, accessible, and enjoyable.

records.name: WanderBuddy
records.tagline: Group travel, handled.
records.description: Group trips currently live across WhatsApp, Google Maps, spreadsheets, Splitwise, notes, and a dozen browser tabs. WanderBuddy puts the entire trip in one place. Plan an itinerary with your group, discover places, build your shared map, chat and call, split expenses, translate conversations, check visa requirements, share your location, and access travel safety tools. No more piecing your trip together across five different apps. Plan together. Travel together. Keep the whole trip in one place.

records.name: dockndevai — MCP server suite
records.tagline: Let agents run real infrastructure, read-only by default
records.description: Eleven open-source, safe-by-default Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that let AI agents operate real infrastructure — Kubernetes, Kafka, ClickHouse, Debezium, OCI, Azure, Azure DevOps, Keycloak, Percona PostgreSQL, Grafana — plus RAG over your own documents. Read-only by default, allowlisted, audited.

records.name: Low Qualityfy
records.tagline: Free browser-based meme and image effects editor.
records.description: Low Qualityfy is a free browser-based image editor and meme maker. Apply deep-fry effects, motion blur, face distortion, pixelation, and white text banners, then download PNG or JPEG files without a watermark. Image processing happens locally in the browser.
